title: com.matrixmedia.room_config
description: State event defining per-room MatrixMedia configuration. State key is the empty string. Sent by the bot or an admin with sufficient power level. Controls stream limits and behavior for the room.

max_participants.description: Maximum number of concurrent participants (host + viewers) allowed in a single stream in this room.

allowed_media_types.description: Media types permitted for streams in this room. Phase 1 supports 'audio' only; 'video' and 'screen_share' are reserved for Phase 2+.

auto_stop_empty_timeout_secs.description: Seconds of zero participants (excluding host) before the server automatically ends the stream. Set to 0 to disable auto-stop.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for this version of the event schema.
